rule: AGENTS.md Theorem-writing policy: state assumptions explicitly and only as strongly as needed
claim: The raw Theorem 12.19 package silently strengthens Hansen's covariance assumption by requiring the full reduced-form covariance Sigma to be positive definite, excluding singular covariance models without documenting or justifying that extra nondegeneracy assumption.
evidence: Hansen (12.74), textbook/ch12/ch12_excerpt.txt:5620-5631, states only E[uu' | Z] = Sigma. The Lean package has field error_covariance_posDef : Sigma.PosDef, and the final endpoint consumes it. Before this review fix, neither the package docstring nor the inventory disclosed that strengthening.
suggested_fix: Either weaken the raw package to covariance positive semidefiniteness and move any genuinely needed nondegeneracy to the minimal generalized-root theorem, or explicitly document and justify Sigma.PosDef as an additional corrected-endpoint assumption in the raw-package/endpoint docstrings and Chapter 12 inventory.
